description: Permit lead times (application to decision, median and quartiles) from official pairs. Currently CLOSED: the answer says CLOSED with the reason until validation gate C passes; no lead time is estimated before that. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.
